|---------|-------------|---------------------|--------|
| Columbia | OV-102 | Contract: 7/26/1972; Rollout: 3/8/1979; First Flight: 4/12/1981 | Lost (2003) |

| Discovery | OV-103 | Ordered: 1/29/1979; First Flight: 3/1984 | Retired |
| Atlantis | OV-104 | Contract: 1/29/1979; First Flight: 10/3/1985 | Retired |
| Endeavour | OV-105 | Built: 1991; First Flight: 5/7/1992 | Retired |

## Missions Landing at Edwards Air Force Base (EAFB):

While I cannot pinpoint which shuttle has the second fewest construction milestones without access to the specific milestone counts in the NASA Reference Guide, I can share that **multiple orbiters did land at EAFB**, including:

**Confirmed EAFB Landings by Orbiter:**
- **Columbia**: STS-1 (first orbital landing at Rogers Dry Lake)
- **Challenger**: STS-7 and several others
- **Discovery**: STS-29 and multiple additional flights
- **Atlantis**: STS-117 and others
- **Endeavour**: Various missions after its maiden flight

The total of approximately 54 missions across the entire program landed at Edwards (typically due to weather at KSC or when the orbiter was ferrying to/from KSC).
